On May 23, 2025, Texas Instruments Incorporated consummated the issuance and sale of $550,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.500% Notes due 2030 and $650,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.100% Notes due 2035, pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated May 20, 2025 among Texas Instruments and Barclays Capital Inc., Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc., as underwriters.
The Notes were issued pursuant to an underwriting agreement filed herewith as Exhibit 1.1 dated May 20, 2025 among Texas Instruments and Barclays Capital Inc., Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and MUFG Securities Americas Inc., as underwriters.

Netflix, Inc. completed a registered public offering of $1 billion in aggregate principal amount of 4.90% senior unsecured notes due 2034 and $800 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.40% senior unsecured notes due 2054 pursuant to an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC.
The Notes were issued pursuant to an underwriting agreement (the 'Underwriting Agreement') with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein.

On September 26, 2025, Oracle Corporation consummated the issuance and sale of $3,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.450% Notes due 2030, $3,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.800% Notes due 2032, $4,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.200% Notes due 2035, $2,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.875% Notes due 2045, $3,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.950% Notes due 2055 and $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 6.100% Notes due 2065 (collectively, the 'Notes'), pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated September 24, 2025.
The Notes were issued pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated September 24, 2025 among Oracle and BofA Securities, Inc., Citigroup Global Markets Inc., Deutsche Bank Securities Inc., Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, HSBC Securities (USA) Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein.

Target Corporation closed the sale of $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5.000% Notes due 2035 pursuant to an Underwriting Agreement dated March 20, 2025 among Target and Citigroup Global Markets Inc., Deutsche Bank Securities Inc., and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters.

On January 24, 2025, the Company issued the following Medium-Term Notes, Series W: (i) $3,000,000,000 Senior Redeemable Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due January 24, 2031; (ii) $2,350,000,000 Senior Redeemable Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due January 24, 2028; and (iii) $650,000,000 Senior Redeemable Floating Rate Notes due January 24, 2028.

On May 12, 2025, Apple Inc. consummated the issuance and sale of $1,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.000% Notes due 2028, $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.200% Notes due 2030, $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.500% Notes due 2032 and $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.750% Notes due 2035, pursuant to an underwriting agreement dated May 5, 2025.
The Notes are being issued pursuant to an underwriting agreement (the 'Underwriting Agreement') dated May 5, 2025 among Apple and Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, Barclays Capital Inc., BofA Securities, Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein.

The Home Depot, Inc. (the "Company") completed a public offering of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.750% Notes due September 15, 2028, $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.950% Notes due September 15, 2030, and $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.650% Notes due September 15, 2035 (collectively, the "Notes").

On September 30, 2025, Lowe's Companies, Inc. (the "Company") issued an aggregate of $5.0 billion of unsecured notes, consisting of $650 million aggregate principal amount of its 3.950% Notes due October 15, 2027, $750 million aggregate principal amount of its 4.000% Notes due October 15, 2028, $1.1 billion aggregate principal amount of its 4.250% Notes due March 15, 2031, $1.3 billion aggregate principal amount of its 4.500% Notes due October 15, 2032 and $1.2 billion aggregate principal amount of its 4.850% Notes due October 15, 2035.
On September 23, 2025, the Company entered into an Underwriting Agreement (the "Underwriting Agreement") with BofA Securities, Inc., Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein (together, the "Underwriters"), to sell to the Underwriters, who severally agreed to purchase, the Notes.

McDonald's Corporation issued $550,000,000 of its 4.400% Medium-Term Notes due 2031 and $750,000,000 of its 5.000% Medium-Term Notes due 2036. The Notes were issued pursuant to the Company's medium-term notes program.

On November 20, 2025, Amazon.com, Inc. (the "Company") closed the sale of $2,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 3.900% notes due 2028, $2,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.100% notes due 2030, $1,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.350% notes due 2033, $3,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.650% notes due 2035, $3,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.450% notes due 2055, and $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.550% notes due 2065 pursuant to an Underwriting Agreement dated November 17, 2025. The aggregate public offering price of the Notes was $14.961 billion and the estimated net proceeds from the offering were approximately $14.926 billion.
